captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a realistic bicycle crankset and pedal assembly. It features a central black bottom-bracket shell with stubby frame tube sections, a large black chainring with detailed perimeter teeth, and two light gray metallic crank arms positioned 180 degrees apart. Attached to the ends of the crank arms are two black textured pedal bodies with visible silver axles. The entire crankset assembly rotates continuously around the bottom-bracket axle, while each pedal body rotates independently on its respective axle.
captions.instruction: Generate a detailed bicycle crankset and pedal assembly. The model should include a central bottom-bracket shell with frame tubes, a sprocket chainring with teeth, dual crank arms positioned 180 degrees apart, and two textured pedals. Configure continuous rotational joints for the main crank spindle and both pedal axles, using realistic metallic gray and matte black materials.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using a series of parts and rotational articulations. First, the bottom-bracket shell is modeled as a cylinder with additional cylindrical tube stubs. Next, the spindle and a detailed chainring (constructed with a circular pattern of triangular teeth subtracted from a thin cylinder) are grouped into the rotating crankset part, along with two tapered crank arms. Finally, two individual pedal bodies are modeled as textured boxes and attached to the crank arms via independent rotational joints, completing the kinematic chain.
